scientific_integrity: The general graded presentation is attributed to the cited primary source. The matrix realization and repeating syzygy are proved explicitly in the result. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes char(k) != 2 and the coordinatewise algebra k×k with projection onto its diagonal. The result is specific to this operator ring and does not classify other Reynolds operators. The older tiled-order literature is broader; priority for this exact application is not settled by abstract-level comparison alone.
title: A two-vertex averaging Reynolds operator ring has a repeating simple-module syzygy
